app_name: NexusTrade AI & Delta India Automated Trading Dashboard

theme.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism & Precision, high-visibility tactical look)

components.card_style: sharp-edge rectangular, 8px max radius, 1px solid border #222222, dense tactical layout
components.navigation: Sticky top glassmorphism bar (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-neutral-800 z-50), with logo, live ticker, navigation tabs, real trading toggle status indicator, and user profile/auth menu.
components.interactive: Shadcn/UI primitives customized with tactical styling, high-contrast focus states, and data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, and tabs.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and interactive elements
accessibility.aria_labels: MANDATORY on all icon buttons, dynamic tickers, and critical trading toggles

image_urls.description: Graphs of performance analytics on a dark monitor
Crypto trading chart and order book interface

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust real trading dashboard connecting to Delta Exchange India API v2 and supporting virtual trading sandbox mode.
Implement Google OAuth login (or Emergent-managed Google login simulation with easy test account bypass for seamless grading/demo).
Create high-performance frontend with React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Recharts for live crypto price feeds and P&L charts.

Build backend in Python FastAPI with database (SQLite/PostgreSQL) for users, API keys (securely stored), virtual balances, real/virtual positions, trade history, strategy parameters, and real-time execution logs.
Include Delta Exchange India real API connection (API Key + Secret Key with HMAC-SHA256 signature generation).
Implement prominent Risk State Banner and explicit 'Real Trading Enabled' toggle switch with zero-accidental order safeguards.
Add Strategy section with enable/disable switches, parameter settings, and a master Engine Start/Stop toggle.
Ensure all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and tabs have proper `data-testid` attributes for automated testing.
Keep navigation sticky with glassmorphism (no completely transparent headers without blur/scrim).
universal_guidelines: Never use forbidden colors (#7351B7 or #1B93A4) or forbidden fonts (Space Grotesk).
Ensure high contrast on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white).
Do not use universal transition: all. Use specific properties.
Ensure mobile responsive layout works cleanly on Android and desktop viewports.
